name: CMRF Key Authentication
description: Authentication provider that logs a user in from a key validated by CiviCRM (via CiviMRF), by URL param, JWT or a login form.
project_description:
This module provides login functionality where the user receives an e-mail from CiviCRM with a code to login (a one time only password). 

 Features 
 
 The actual users while be retrieved from CiviCRM 
 Users are authenticated against CiviCRM. So the logic for a valid users should reside in CiviCRM and requires additional configuration in CiviCRM 
 Supports one-time login links with an e-mail address and a code 
 
 Post-Installation 
 You need to configure this module after installation.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the CMRF Core module and a (remote) CiviCRM
